description: This file defines the MenuProvider class, which manages menu data for restaurants by fetching data from an API service and notifying listeners about state changes.

classes.name: MenuProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier subclass that handles fetching and providing menu data for restaurants.

methods.name: menuFor
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of MenuItem objects for a specific restaurant.

methods.name: fetchMenu
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches menu data for a given restaurant ID and updates the internal state.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Getter that indicates whether a fetch operation is currently in progress.
